description:
A Codebase Health issue by its Pharaoh ID: one repo's exact duplicates, dependency cycles or complex functions, or one finding among them.

CALL THIS WHEN:
• A prompt or an earlier answer gives you an issue ID (pharaoh:owner/repo:…)

RETURNS: The repo's live Health score and mapped commit; each finding's ID, files, related findings and file-disjoint group; and the points its removal adds to the score.

cursor.description: The next-page cursor from the previous answer
